facts.fact: PTI reports the authority fined a company for failing to notify it and obtain authorisation for an international transfer of personal data, so a rule requiring authorisation is in force.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data

facts.fact: PTI reports the authority fined Crescer Tech USD 505,000, its largest 2026 fine, for storing personal data in a cloud outside Angola without notification or authorisation.
facts.system: Authorisation for international transfer of personal data
